case.title: Customer switches from English to Hindi mid-call
case.source: calleval: language switching (not covered by ElevenLabs guide, which treats languages as platform-level)
case.goal: Book an appointment for tomorrow at 10 AM, any doctor
quirks: Start in English. From your second reply onward speak only Hindi (Devanagari or Hinglish), e.g. 'haan, kal subah dus baje chahiye'
case.precondition: Customer spoke Hindi/Hinglish in at least two consecutive turns.
criteria: After the customer switched to Hindi, the agent replied in Hindi/Hinglish rather than staying in English
The agent kept the context (did not restart the booking flow or re-ask answered questions)
The booking details (date, time) stayed correct across the language switch

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hello, I want to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten AM with any doctor.
We have Dr. Rajendra Prasad for General Medicine and Dr. Akram Syed for Pediatrics. Whom would you like to see?
haan, koi bhi chalega, bas kal subah dus baje ka time chahiye.
Could you please confirm your full name for the booking?
I have ten in the morning tomorrow at Koramangala with Dr. Akram Syed. Shall I lock it in?
haan, theek hai, wohi book kar do.
Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at ten in the morning at Koramangala with Dr. Akram Syed. Is there anything else I can help with?
bas itna hi chahiye tha, shukriya. bye.
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
